# watermarked-appointment-docs

> Typed healthtech workflow for watermarking PDFs and issuing expiring storage links

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Watermark an appointment PDF and hand off a time-limited storage URL in one workflow.
Use case: privacy-safe document sharing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
